facts.fact: Agence Ivoirienne de Presse reports the interior ministry said the annual birth registration rate rose from 54.7% in 2022 to 57.6% in 2025, a national rate not tied to a digital system.

CIV.note: Birth registration rate of 57.6% is not the births-and-deaths target (births at all, deaths at 80%); no ID enrolment count given.
